data.name: Index.Intro.Line1
data.value: NCF (NeuCharFramework) is an enterprise-grade, general-purpose .NET framework for building foundational applications.

data.name: Index.Intro.Line2
data.value: It follows DDD principles and includes caching, databases, models, validation, and an administration dashboard.

data.name: Index.Intro.Line3
data.value: Its highly modular design provides excellent extensibility and reliability.

data.name: Index.Feature.AiNative.Text

data.name: Index.Feature.Modular.Text
data.value: Combine and extend highly modular components. Each feature module can be developed, tested, integrated, and deployed independently.

data.name: Index.Feature.HighPerformance.Text
data.value: More than a decade of enterprise optimization experience delivers high performance and availability to systems handling over five million daily page views.

data.name: Index.Feature.Ddd.Text
